title: A New Error Analysis for a Point Tracking Elliptic Distributed Optimal Control Problem with Pointwise Control Constraints
summary: We develop a concise error analysis for a linear-quadratic elliptic distributed optimal control problem with point tracking and pointwise control constraints, where a standard finite element discretization and a variational discretization are treated in a unified framework. The analysis is self-contained modulo standard techniques in finite element analysis and classical results for elliptic partial differential equations.
